text: Symbol ambiguity resolved this morning (new, not on the standing list): `VHYA.DE` and `VHYL.DE` both return 404 on Yahoo, so the Amsterdam line `VHYL.AS` was used; `UBU7.DE` resolves but `UBS7.DE` does not; the Yahoo European index series `^STOXX` is labelled "STXE 600 I" (Zurich) rather than the STOXX 600 total-return index the fund tracks.
